config.title: Config
config.subtitle: The deployment's config file, for everything without its own screen: memory, prompts, tools, MCP, triggers, search, files, net and runtime settings. Saving keeps a .bak; topology changes apply at the next restart.
config.directoryNote: In a directory deployment Studio edits the fragments through Agents, Channels, Models and Safety; other sections are edited in the files themselves.
config.reloadDiscard: Reload the file from disk and discard your unsaved edits?
config.revertDiscard: Revert the editor to the file as it was loaded and discard your unsaved edits?
config.valid: Valid: the runtime would boot with this config (strict fields, env expansion and cross-references checked).
config.validWithNote: Valid: the runtime would boot with this config (strict fields, env expansion and cross-references checked). {note}
config.saveMessage: Validate and replace {path}? The current file is kept as .bak. Most changes apply when AgentFlow restarts.
config.conflict: The file changed on disk since it was loaded. Reload it (your edits are discarded) and apply them again.
config.editsCopied: your edits are on the clipboard
config.directoryHelp: The directory is on the runtime's machine. Edit the fragments there and restart AgentFlow, or use the screens below for the parts Studio manages.
config.editHint: Env placeholders stay as written ({placeholder}); secrets are never resolved into this text. {mod}+S validates and saves.
config.maskedHint: What the runtime parsed from the file on disk, with sensitive keys masked. Read-only.
config.maskedHintDirty: What the runtime parsed from the file on disk, with sensitive keys masked. Read-only. Your unsaved edits are not in it.
config.noParse: The file on disk does not parse as YAML, so there is no structured view of it.
